activities.name: Climbing Mount Fuji
activities.note: climbing above the 5th stations outside the official season is prohibited by law - the trails are unmaintained, the huts shut, and the mountain carries snow and ice

windows.reason: the official climbing season: trails, mountain huts and transport all open. The Yoshida and Subashiri trails usually open 1 July, Fujinomiya and Gotemba around 10 July
the season ends around 10 September and everything closes behind it

activities.name: Cherry blossom (sakura)
activities.note: a two-week bloom rather than a season, forecast afresh each year - a given tree holds its flowers for about ten days

windows.reason: on the 1991-2020 average Tokyo's benchmark tree reaches full bloom around 31 March, with Kyoto and Osaka three to five days later; the bloom front then moves north through April

activities.name: Skiing in Hokkaido
activities.note: Hokkaido's summers are cool and dry rather than hot and humid, which is a different reason to go and not a skiing one

windows.reason: world-class powder in the depths of the northern winter
the shoulders of the ski season

activities.name: Autumn colour (koyo)
activities.note: the front runs the opposite way to the cherry blossom — south from Hokkaido rather than north from Kyushu

windows.reason: maple, ginkgo and ash turn from October into early November; Hokkaido peaks first, in October
